iterations.summary: Unmodified efc7f0da baseline and WSL cycle reproduction.
Rejected merged FP32/FP64 FMA area-sharing trial; functional but substantially worse TNS.
Accepted fourth ADDMUL pipeline stage placed before the wide FMA adder; PARALLEL FMA and branch predictor retained.
Reset-free FMA pre-adder payload and first fully unified 120 MHz hardware/software build; function passed but timing was rejected.
Selected final improve_v2 implementation: a fifth ADDMUL boundary and fourth CONV boundary split normalization/adjustment from rounding at a unified 120 MHz.

Removed architectural and implementation support for FP64 while retaining RV32F; narrowed the FP register/execute/memory paths to 32 bits and kept the branch predictor RTL unchanged. The unified 120 MHz build passed functional gates and the cycle limit, but did not meet the zero-violation requirement for promotion to 150 MHz.

board_safety.rule: Hardware MMCM, SoC/timer clock contract, UART divisor, CoreMark ticks per second and embedded BRAM image must be generated for the same frequency.
board_safety.reason: Changing only the MMCM creates a bitstream whose UART/timer/CoreMark timebase does not match the firmware.
